kiosk_seller.text: Cash only, and now the tolls are gone there is nobody to give me any. I sell sandwiches and sympathy.
The Severn has one of the biggest tides in the world, about 14 metres. On the biggest spring tides a wave called the Severn Bore rushes up the river and people surf it.
Do not try to catch the bore on foot. It is quicker than you, and the mud is much worse.
